ideas.title: Investigation into $380 Million Medicaid Billing Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the $380 million Medicaid billing fraud linked to a single building in Minnesota. The angle would be to follow the money and see where it leads.
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and could lead to significant consequences for those involved.

ideas.title: Analysis of Childcare Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would analyze the impact of the White House's push to freeze childcare funding on low-income families in Minnesota. The angle would be to examine the potential consequences of this policy change.
questions: What are the impacts on low-income families?
Are there any alternatives to the funding freeze?
How can this issue be addressed?
ideas.insight: This story could provide valuable insight into the impact of policy changes on vulnerable populations.
